faq.q: What is Prairie in GTA VI?
faq.a: Prairie is a fictional fast-food chain shown in a TV advert during the Extended Look video, reported by GamesRadar+.

faq.q: What does the Prairie advert say in the Extended Look?
faq.a: It advertises a sandwich box meal at "only 30,000 calories," a joke figure noted by GamesRadar+.

faq.q: What real chain does Prairie parody in GTA VI?
faq.a: GamesRadar+ says the advert parodies real fast-food chains such as Arby's.

faq.q: Can you visit a Prairie restaurant in GTA VI?
faq.a: The facts file does not confirm this. Only the TV advert has been reported so far, not a physical location.
